card.name: Exceptions inside contraindication wording
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a contraindication or exception clause, just before a qualifier such as 'to', 'unless', or 'that do not'. Examples are 'secondary', 'aura', 'result', 'confirmed', and 'reaction' in a 'history of hypersensitivity reaction to' phrase.

modes.label: Unless-clause exceptions
modes.description: A word inside an 'unless ... is secondary/a result of' exception that limits a contraindication.
modes.example: unless the congestive heart failure or hypotension is<< secondary>> to cardiac arrhythmia.

modes.label: Condition qualifiers
modes.description: A qualifying word closing a condition name, before the text says what follows from it.
modes.example: migraine headache without<< aura>>, that do not contraindicate

modes.label: Hypersensitivity history
modes.description: The word 'reaction' in a list of contraindications, right before 'to' and a drug name.
modes.example: History of a serious hypersensitivity<< reaction>> to dabigatran, dabig

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for a conditional or qualifying continuation, such as 'unless', 'only if', or 'specifically'.
card.plain: It lights up on the words in a contraindication that set up an exception or a condition, just before the qualifier comes.
